notes: Cache torch.linalg.cholesky(R) once per fit_rss and reuse via torch.cholesky_solve in _compute_elbo (called once per IBSS outer iteration). Replaces O(p^3) linalg.solve with O(p^2) substitution. R is constant across IBSS iterations so the factor amortises across max_iter calls. Bench against AR(1) rho=0.5 LD, L=10, n_causal=3, estimate_prior_method='optim'.
what_this_unlocks: Extension A's native IBSS sweep speedup was capped near 1x at p>=1000 because torch.linalg.solve in _compute_elbo (O(p^3) per outer iteration) dominated. With the Cholesky cache, ELBO drops from ~875ms to ~10ms per call at p=2000, and the full fit_rss speedup tracks the kernel speedup. Combined Tier 1 A + cache delivers 5-11x at typical fine-mapping sizes (p in [500, 2000]).
